question: List all customers who have initiated at least one payment transaction and the total amount they have transacted, sorted by the total amount in descending order.
sql: SELECT graph.customer_name, graph.total_amount FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('financial_payment', 'MATCH (c:Customer)-[:Initiates]->(pt:PaymentTransaction) GROUP BY c.name RETURN c.name AS customer_name, SUM(pt.amount) AS total_amount ORDER BY total_amount DESC') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(customer_name VARCHAR(255) PATH '$[0]', total_amount INT PATH '$[1]')) AS graph

sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('financial_payment', 'MATCH (m:Merchant)<-[:ProcessedFor]-(pt:PaymentTransaction)-[:GovernedBy]->(cr:ComplianceRule) GROUP BY m.business_name RETURN m.business_name AS merchant_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.jurisdiction)')

question: Calculate the average transaction amount for each merchant category code, considering only those transactions that were completed and had a risk assessment score below 50, and display the results ordered by average amount in descending order.
sql: SELECT graph.category_code, graph.avg_transaction_amount FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('financial_payment', 'MATCH (m:Merchant)<-[:ProcessedFor]-(pt:PaymentTransaction {status: ''Completed''})-[:HasRiskAssessment]->(ra:RiskAssessment) WHERE ra.score < 50 GROUP BY m.category_code RETURN m.category_code, AVG(pt.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount ORDER BY avg_transaction_amount DESC') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(category_code VARCHAR(255) PATH '$[0]', avg_transaction_amount DOUBLE PATH '$[1]')) AS graph
sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('financial_payment', 'MATCH (m:Merchant)<-[:ProcessedFor]-(pt:PaymentTransaction {status: ''Completed''})-[:HasRiskAssessment]->(ra:RiskAssessment) WHERE ra.score < 50 GROUP BY m.category_code RETURN m.category_code, AVG(pt.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount ORDER BY avg_transaction_amount DESC')

sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('financial_payment', 'MATCH (c:Customer)-[:Initiates]->(pt:PaymentTransaction {status: ''Completed''})-[:ProcessedFor]->(m:Merchant) GROUP BY m.business_name RETURN m.business_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS unique_customers_count ORDER BY unique_customers_count DESC LIMIT 5')

question: Retrieve the top 5 customers by total transaction amount in EUR, including their name and the sum of amounts, considering only completed transactions.

sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('financial_payment', 'MATCH (m:Merchant)<-[:ProcessedFor]-(pt:PaymentTransaction)-[:ReceivesTo]->(a:Account) WHERE a.balance > 5000 GROUP BY m.business_name RETURN m.business_name AS merchant_name, COUNT(pt) AS transaction_count')

question: Find accounts that have had transactions with at least three distinct payment methods and display the account ID along with the count of distinct methods.
sql: SELECT graph.account_id, graph.COUNTDISTINCT FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('financial_payment', 'MATCH (a:Account)<-[:FundsFrom]-(pt:PaymentTransaction)-[:AuthorizedBy]->(pm:PaymentMethod) GROUP BY a.account_id RETURN a.account_id AS account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pm)') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(account_id INT PATH '$[0]', COUNTDISTINCT INT PATH '$[1]')) AS graph
sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('financial_payment', 'MATCH (a:Account)<-[:FundsFrom]-(pt:PaymentTransaction)-[:AuthorizedBy]->(pm:PaymentMethod) GROUP BY a.account_id RETURN a.account_id AS account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pm)')

sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('financial_payment', 'MATCH (c:Customer)-[:Initiates]->(pt:PaymentTransaction)-[:AuthorizedBy]->(pm:PaymentMethod) GROUP BY c.name RETURN c.name, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.provider)')

question: Find customers who have initiated transactions with at least three different merchants in the same category code, displaying customer name, category code, and the number of distinct merchants, ordered by the number of merchants descending.
sql: SELECT graph.name, graph.category_code, graph.COUNTDISTINCT FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('financial_payment', 'MATCH (c:Customer)-[:Initiates]->(pt:PaymentTransaction)-[:ProcessedFor]->(m:Merchant) GROUP BY c.name, m.category_code RETURN c.name, m.category_code, COUNT(DISTINCT m.merchant_id) ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT m.merchant_id) DESC') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(name VARCHAR(255) PATH '$[0]', category_code VARCHAR(255) PATH '$[1]', COUNTDISTINCT INT PATH '$[2]')) AS graph
sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('financial_payment', 'MATCH (c:Customer)-[:Initiates]->(pt:PaymentTransaction)-[:ProcessedFor]->(m:Merchant) GROUP BY c.name, m.category_code RETURN c.name, m.category_code, COUNT(DISTINCT m.merchant_id) ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT m.merchant_id) DESC')

question: Find customers who have initiated transactions that were governed by compliance rules effective after January 1, 2023, and return their names along with the rule descriptions and the count of such transactions, ordered by transaction count descending.
sql: SELECT graph.customer_name, graph.rule_description, graph.transaction_count FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('financial_payment', 'MATCH (c:Customer)-[:Initiates]->(pt:PaymentTransaction)-[:GovernedBy]->(cr:ComplianceRule) WHERE cr.effective_date > ''2023-01-01'' GROUP BY c.name, cr.description RETURN c.name AS customer_name, cr.description AS rule_description, COUNT(pt) AS transaction_count ORDER BY transaction_count DESC') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(customer_name VARCHAR(255) PATH '$[0]', rule_description TEXT PATH '$[1]', transaction_count INT PATH '$[2]')) AS graph
sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('financial_payment', 'MATCH (c:Customer)-[:Initiates]->(pt:PaymentTransaction)-[:GovernedBy]->(cr:ComplianceRule) WHERE cr.effective_date > ''2023-01-01'' GROUP BY c.name, cr.description RETURN c.name AS customer_name, cr.description AS rule_description, COUNT(pt) AS transaction_count ORDER BY transaction_count DESC')

question: Show the distribution of transaction statuses for each merchant in the 'Retail' category, returning the merchant's business name, status, and the count of transactions for each status.

question: Retrieve the list of accounts that have sent funds (via outgoing transactions) and received funds (via incoming transactions) where both sets of transactions have a risk level of 'Low'. Include the account ID, the total amount sent, and the total amount received.

question: Identify merchants who have processed transactions with at least three different customers whose accounts have a balance exceeding 5000, and return the merchant business name along with the total transaction amount for each.
sql: SELECT graph.business_name, graph.SUMamount FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('financial_payment', 'MATCH (m:Merchant)<-[:ProcessedFor]-(pt:PaymentTransaction)-[:FundsFrom]->(a:Account)<-[:ReceivesTo]-(pt2:PaymentTransaction)<-[:Initiates]-(c:Customer), (m)<-[:ProcessedFor]-(pt3:PaymentTransaction)<-[:Initiates]-(c) WHERE a.balance > 5000 GROUP BY m.business_name RETURN m.business_name, SUM(amount)') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(business_name VARCHAR(255) PATH '$[0]', SUMamount INT PATH '$[1]')) AS graph
sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('financial_payment', 'MATCH (m:Merchant)<-[:ProcessedFor]-(pt:PaymentTransaction)-[:FundsFrom]->(a:Account)<-[:ReceivesTo]-(pt2:PaymentTransaction)<-[:Initiates]-(c:Customer), (m)<-[:ProcessedFor]-(pt3:PaymentTransaction)<-[:Initiates]-(c) WHERE a.balance > 5000 GROUP BY m.business_name RETURN m.business_name, SUM(amount)')

question: For each payment method type, calculate the average risk score of transactions authorized by that method, excluding methods with no associated risk assessments.

sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('financial_payment', 'MATCH (pm:PaymentMethod)<-[:AuthorizedBy]-(pt:PaymentTransaction)-[:HasRiskAssessment]->(ra:RiskAssessment) GROUP BY pm.method_type RETURN pm.method_type, AVG(ra.score) AS average_risk_score ORDER BY average_risk_score DESC')

question: Find accounts that have processed transactions with at least two different merchants and calculate the average transaction amount for each account, displaying only those with an average amount greater than 500.
sql: SELECT graph.account_id, graph.amount, graph.COUNTDISTINCT FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('financial_payment', 'MATCH (a:Account)<-[:ReceivesTo]-(pt:PaymentTransaction)-[:ProcessedFor]->(m:Merchant) GROUP BY a.account_id RETURN a.account_id, AVG(pt.amount), COUNT(DISTINCT m)') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(account_id INT PATH '$[0]', amount DOUBLE PATH '$[1]', COUNTDISTINCT INT PATH '$[2]')) AS graph
sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('financial_payment', 'MATCH (a:Account)<-[:ReceivesTo]-(pt:PaymentTransaction)-[:ProcessedFor]->(m:Merchant) GROUP BY a.account_id RETURN a.account_id, AVG(pt.amount), COUNT(DISTINCT m)')

question: Find all accounts that have both sent and received funds, where the total amount sent exceeds the total amount received. Return the account ID, total sent, and total received amounts.
sql: SELECT graph.account_id, graph.amount, graph.amount_1 FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('financial_payment', 'MATCH (a:Account)<-[:FundsFrom]-(pt_sent:PaymentTransaction), (a:Account)<-[:ReceivesTo]-(pt_received:PaymentTransaction) GROUP BY a.account_id RETURN a.account_id, SUM(pt_sent.amount), SUM(pt_received.amount)') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(account_id INT PATH '$[0]', amount INT PATH '$[1]', amount_1 INT PATH '$[2]')) AS graph
sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('financial_payment', 'MATCH (a:Account)<-[:FundsFrom]-(pt_sent:PaymentTransaction), (a:Account)<-[:ReceivesTo]-(pt_received:PaymentTransaction) GROUP BY a.account_id RETURN a.account_id, SUM(pt_sent.amount), SUM(pt_received.amount)')

sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('financial_payment', 'MATCH (n1:PaymentTransaction)-[]->{1,3}(n2:Account) WHERE n1.amount = 6.88 RETURN n2.account_id, n2.account_type LIMIT 5')

sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('financial_payment', 'MATCH (c:Customer)-[:Initiates]->(pt:PaymentTransaction)-[:AuthorizedBy]->(pm:PaymentMethod) WHERE pm.method_type = ''Credit Card'' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name RETURN c.customer_id, c.name, COUNT(pt.transaction_id) AS credit_card_transaction_count')

question: Identify accounts that have been involved in payment transactions with risk assessments scoring above 90, and return the account ID, currency, and the highest risk score associated with any of its transactions.
sql: SELECT graph.account_id, graph.currency, graph.max_risk_score FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('financial_payment', 'MATCH (a:Account)<-[:FundsFrom|ReceivesTo]-(pt:PaymentTransaction)-[:HasRiskAssessment]->(ra:RiskAssessment) WHERE ra.score > 90 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.currency RETURN a.account_id, a.currency, MAX(ra.score) AS max_risk_score') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(account_id INT PATH '$[0]', currency VARCHAR(255) PATH '$[1]', max_risk_score DOUBLE PATH '$[2]')) AS graph
sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('financial_payment', 'MATCH (a:Account)<-[:FundsFrom|ReceivesTo]-(pt:PaymentTransaction)-[:HasRiskAssessment]->(ra:RiskAssessment) WHERE ra.score > 90 GROUP BY a.account_id, a.currency RETURN a.account_id, a.currency, MAX(ra.score) AS max_risk_score')

sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('financial_payment', 'MATCH (pm:PaymentMethod)<-[:AuthorizedBy]-(pt:PaymentTransaction)-[:GovernedBy]->(r:ComplianceRule) GROUP BY pm.method_id, pm.masked_identifier, pm.provider RETURN pm.method_id, pm.masked_identifier, pm.provider, COUNT(DISTINCT r.rule_id)')

question: List all compliance rules that govern at least one completed payment transaction in USD, and return the rule_id, jurisdiction, rule_type, and the total amount of governed transactions.
sql: SELECT graph.rule_id, graph.jurisdiction, graph.rule_type, graph.total_governed_amount FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('financial_payment', 'MATCH (cr:ComplianceRule)<-[:GovernedBy]-(pt:PaymentTransaction) WHERE pt.status = ''Completed'' AND pt.currency = ''USD'' GROUP BY cr.rule_id, cr.jurisdiction, cr.rule_type RETURN cr.rule_id, cr.jurisdiction, cr.rule_type, SUM(pt.amount) AS total_governed_amount') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(rule_id INT PATH '$[0]', jurisdiction VARCHAR(255) PATH '$[1]', rule_type VARCHAR(255) PATH '$[2]', total_governed_amount INT PATH '$[3]')) AS graph
sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('financial_payment', 'MATCH (cr:ComplianceRule)<-[:GovernedBy]-(pt:PaymentTransaction) WHERE pt.status = ''Completed'' AND pt.currency = ''USD'' GROUP BY cr.rule_id, cr.jurisdiction, cr.rule_type RETURN cr.rule_id, cr.jurisdiction, cr.rule_type, SUM(pt.amount) AS total_governed_amount')

question: For each customer with KYC status 'Verified', find their most recently used payment method (based on transaction created_at), and return the customer_id, name, method_id, method_type, and the timestamp of last use.

question: List all payment methods that have never been used in any completed transaction, returning their method_id, method_type, and provider.
sql: SELECT graph.method_id, graph.method_type, graph.provider FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('financial_payment', 'MATCH (pm:PaymentMethod) WHERE NOT EXISTS{ (pm)<-[:AuthorizedBy]-(pt:PaymentTransaction {status: ''Completed''}) } RETURN pm.method_id, pm.method_type, pm.provider') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(method_id INT PATH '$[0]', method_type VARCHAR(255) PATH '$[1]', provider INT PATH '$[2]')) AS graph
sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('financial_payment', 'MATCH (pm:PaymentMethod) WHERE NOT EXISTS{ (pm)<-[:AuthorizedBy]-(pt:PaymentTransaction {status: ''Completed''}) } RETURN pm.method_id, pm.method_type, pm.provider')

question: Retrieve audit logs for payment transactions that were initiated by customers with KYC status 'Rejected', including the log ID, event type, timestamp, and the associated transaction reference number.
sql: SELECT graph.log_id, graph.event_type, graph.timestamp, graph.reference_number FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('financial_payment', 'MATCH (c:Customer{kyc_status:''Rejected''})-[:Initiates]->(pt:PaymentTransaction)-[:HasAuditLog]->(al:AuditLog) RETURN al.log_id, al.event_type, al.timestamp, pt.reference_number') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(log_id INT PATH '$[0]', event_type VARCHAR(255) PATH '$[1]', timestamp VARCHAR(255) PATH '$[2]', reference_number VARCHAR(255) PATH '$[3]')) AS graph
sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('financial_payment', 'MATCH (c:Customer{kyc_status:''Rejected''})-[:Initiates]->(pt:PaymentTransaction)-[:HasAuditLog]->(al:AuditLog) RETURN al.log_id, al.event_type, al.timestamp, pt.reference_number')

question: Retrieve merchants that have processed transactions using payment methods with status 'Expired', and for each such merchant, return the merchant ID, business name, and the earliest expiry date among all associated expired payment methods.
sql: SELECT graph.merchant_id, graph.business_name, graph.earliest_expiry FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(frogql_traverse('financial_payment', 'MATCH (m:Merchant)<-[:ProcessedFor]-(pt:PaymentTransaction)-[:AuthorizedBy]->(pm:PaymentMethod) WHERE pm.status = ''Expired'' GROUP BY m.merchant_id, m.business_name RETURN m.merchant_id, m.business_name, MIN(pm.expiry_date) AS earliest_expiry') USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS(merchant_id INT PATH '$[0]', business_name VARCHAR(255) PATH '$[1]', earliest_expiry INT PATH '$[2]')) AS graph
sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('financial_payment', 'MATCH (m:Merchant)<-[:ProcessedFor]-(pt:PaymentTransaction)-[:AuthorizedBy]->(pm:PaymentMethod) WHERE pm.status = ''Expired'' GROUP BY m.merchant_id, m.business_name RETURN m.merchant_id, m.business_name, MIN(pm.expiry_date) AS earliest_expiry')
